subject: GCP private offer: proposed amortization & invoice phasing for Pegasus IO
messages:
From: Alex Murphy <alex@pegasus.io>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer questions — invoice timing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through the private offer last week. Before our CFO signs we need two things clarified:

1) How will the committed credit be invoiced and how does that map to the private-offer redemption? We have quarterly financial close and need predictable invoice dates.
2) Is it possible to amortize the commitment over 4 quarters for recognition / cash flow planning vs. a single upfront charge?

I've attached the signed PO draft for reference. Can your finance team propose a sample amortization schedule and the expected GCP invoice dates so our treasury team can sign off?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we hope to finalize by the end of the month.

— Alex
Alex Murphy
Head of Platform
Pegasus IO

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer questions — invoice timing

Alex — thanks for the note and the PO. We're aligned on timing to close this month. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood invoices customers for the portion of the private-offer we submit for redemption to GCP; GCP issues credits against their billing. We commonly submit redemption batches monthly or quarterly based on customer preference and Marketplace constraints.
- We can propose an amortization schedule (spread the recognized commitment across 4 quarters) and present a corresponding invoice schedule to match your fiscal policy. However, the exact GCP credit application date depends on the private-offer redemption window and Google processing (typically 7–21 business days after submission).

I'm looping in Marissa (Revenue Ops) and Ben (Partnerships) to draft a proposed amortization table with two options:
  A) Quarterly redemption + quarterly invoices (spread evenly)
  B) Front-loaded first-quarter then tapered redemption to accelerate go-live consumption credits

We'll share the spreadsheet and a recommended cadence by EOD Wednesday. If Pegasus legal/tax needs a different structure (e.g., invoice in arrears vs. in advance) flag that and we'll incorporate.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head, Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Murphy <alex@pegasus.io>, Pegasus Finance <billing@pegasus.io>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:33:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed amortization schedule & invoice phasing for Pegasus IO

Folks — attaching the proposed amortization schedule (amortization_schedule_v1.xlsx) and the GCP line items CSV. Summary of the two recommended options: 

Option 1 — Even quarterly amortization (recommended for predictable revenue recognition)
- Total committed credit: $480,000
- Quarterly invoiced amount: $120,000
- Proposed redemption submissions to GCP: first week of each quarter (aim to hit credit application within the quarter)
- Pros: matches Pegasus quarter close cadence, simplifies treasury forecasting
- Cons: potential delay in credit application if GCP processing slips (we include buffer days)

Option 2 — Front-loaded (accelerated first quarter)
- Quarter 1: $240,000
- Quarter 2–4: $80,000 each
- Proposed redemption: submit larger first batch to secure credits early for initial ramp
- Pros: helps Pegasus offset early consumption; better for payroll/launch costs
- Cons: less even revenue recognition; potential impact on couponing/backfill if consumption low

Operational notes: 
- We'll submit each redemption as a private-offer batch via the GCP Marketplace portal. Google Credit application historically takes 7–15 business days; we'll pad our timeline to 21 days for safety.
- Attachments: amortization_schedule_v1.xlsx (breakdown by invoice date and GL mapping), GCP_private_offer_lineitems.csv (SKU-level mapping required for GCP).

Action items: 
1) Alex — confirm preferred option (1 or 2) and preferred invoice payment terms (net 30 vs. net 45).
2) Pegasus Finance — confirm billing email and AR contact for DocuSign routing.
3) Karthik/Ben/Evelyn — I'll coordinate with Google to confirm redemption windows after Pegasus confirms option.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi team at Google — forwarding Pegasus' requested approach. We're aiming to finalize the private-offer redemption cadence and corresponding GCP invoice schedule for RDW-2026-PEGA-003. Can you please confirm: 

1) If we submit the private-offer redemption batches on these tentative dates (see attached amortization sheet), can Google guarantee credit application within 15 business days? If not, what is a conservative SLA we should model?
2) Any restrictions on submitting multiple redemption batches within a 30-day window for the same private offer?
3) Confirmation of the exact invoice ID format GCP will generate so Pegasus can match payments to credits for reconciliation.

Alex — please reply with the option you prefer (Option 1 or Option 2) and your AR contact so we can get DocuSign live. We'll hold an ops call with Google once they confirm processing SLAs.

Thanks — Ben
